'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]] [[Treasure Trails]].

Searching the chest displays the chatbox message "The chest is locked!  Crude graffiti on the chest reads: 'Barbarians rule ok!", hinting that the key to open it is dropped by [[barbarian]]s.
